players.sql: SELECT id,name,country,`rank`,ytd_wins,ytd_losses,elo_rank,elo_rank_hard FROM players WHERE id IN (%s,%s)

h2h.sql: SELECT e.date AS event_start_date,e.name,e.type,e.surface,m.round,w.name AS winner,l.name AS loser,m.score,m.status FROM matches m JOIN events e ON e.id=m.event JOIN players w ON w.id=m.winner JOIN players l ON l.id=m.loser WHERE (m.winner=%s AND m.loser=%s) OR (m.winner=%s AND m.loser=%s) ORDER BY e.date DESC,m.id DESC

form.sql: SELECT m.id,e.date AS event_start_date,e.name,e.type,e.surface,m.round,m.winner,m.loser,w.name AS winner_name,l.name AS loser_name,m.score,m.status FROM matches m JOIN events e ON e.id=m.event JOIN players w ON w.id=m.winner JOIN players l ON l.id=m.loser WHERE (m.winner IN (%s,%s) OR m.loser IN (%s,%s)) AND e.date >= %s AND e.date <= %s ORDER BY e.date DESC,CASE m.round WHEN 'F' THEN 10 WHEN 'SF' THEN 9 WHEN 'QF' THEN 8 WHEN 'R16' THEN 7 WHEN 'R32' THEN 6 WHEN 'R64' THEN 5 WHEN 'R128' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END DESC,m.id DESC
